Speech Anonymizer

Record, upload, transcribe, edit, and anonymize speech with advanced AI models.

ℹ️ Model & Language

Select the appropriate language for the file you want to process. Auto-select can be wrong, and incorrect identification can lead to transcription errors and failure to properly de-identify!

Larger models will have better transcript accuracy, but take longer. If you are running this tool locally on a CPU-only device, use a smaller model.

Loading available tags...

ℹ️ PII Categories

You may wish to keep certain information in the transcript, rather than removing it. Keeping this information rather than removing it may make the text more identifiable, but perhaps you need it for your analysis.

Anonymized Text

ℹ️ Anonymization Output

Double check the output text. Machine processing miss identifying information or wrongly remove information. Double check it is correct! Edit it if it is not.

Use the rephrase function to change the phrasing, which can also be identifying. Replace removed information with fake alternatives for a more natural-sounding text.

Click Synthetic Audio if you want an audio file with fake voices speaking the de-identified text.
